title: infra-aws: idleClientTimeout set on the billing DBProxy
author: CI pipeline (infrastructure team)
summary: Applied the infra-aws repository. Added the idleClientTimeout field to the DBProxy resource billing-db-proxy (namespace ack-system). The field was not set, so the proxy fell back to the AWS default of 1800 s. Goal stated in the merge request: purge idle client connections earlier, as the RDS Proxy documentation explicitly allows.
review: Two approvals from the infrastructure team. No value was overwritten and the resource carried no comment: there was nothing to contradict.
tags: infrastructure aws rds proxy dbproxy idleclienttimeout idle timeout idle connections ack billing
